findings.detail: Description of "check_breach" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_link, check_email, check_breach · Private data: check_wallet, check_breach · Public sink: check_email, check_breach · Destructive: check_wallet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_link, check_email, check_breach · Private data: check_wallet, check_breach · Public sink: check_email, check_breach · Destructive: check_wallet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
